en.t: My town: places in the city
en.g: Name the places in your town and say what you do there.
p: Places: bank, supermarket, post office, library, station, park.
Say what you do there: I buy food at the supermarket; I borrow books from the library.
Use near and far from: The station is near my house.
en.q: What places are near your home? Name three.
en.c: Name in English every place you pass today, or five places you know well.

de.t: Meine Stadt: Orte in der Stadt
de.g: Du lernst die Orte deiner Stadt und sagst, was du dort machst.
p: Orte: bank, supermarket, post office, library, station, park.
Sag, was du dort machst: I buy food at the supermarket; I borrow books from the library.
Benutze near und far from: The station is near my house.
de.q: Welche Orte sind in der Nähe deiner Wohnung? Nenn drei.
de.c: Benenne heute jeden Ort, an dem du vorbeikommst, auf Englisch, oder fünf, die du gut kennst.

es.t: Mi ciudad: lugares de la ciudad
es.g: Aprende los lugares de tu ciudad y a decir qué haces en ellos.
p: Lugares: bank, supermarket, post office, library, station, park.
Di qué haces allí: I buy food at the supermarket; I borrow books from the library.
Usa near y far from: The station is near my house.
es.q: ¿Qué lugares hay cerca de tu casa? Nombra tres.
es.c: Nombra hoy en inglés cada lugar por el que pases, o cinco lugares que conozcas bien.

fr.t: Ma ville : les lieux de la ville
fr.g: Nommer les lieux de ta ville et dire ce que tu y fais.
p: Lieux : bank, supermarket, post office, library, station, park.
Dis ce que tu y fais : I buy food at the supermarket ; I borrow books from the library.
Utilise near et far from : The station is near my house.
fr.q: Quels lieux sont près de chez toi ? Cites-en trois.
fr.c: Nomme en anglais chaque lieu devant lequel tu passes aujourd'hui, ou cinq lieux que tu connais.

it.t: La mia città: i luoghi in città
it.g: Impari i luoghi della tua città e a dire cosa ci fai.
p: Luoghi: bank, supermarket, post office, library, station, park.
Di' cosa ci fai: I buy food at the supermarket; I borrow books from the library.
Usa near e far from: The station is near my house.
it.q: Quali luoghi ci sono vicino a casa tua? Nominane tre.
it.c: Nomina oggi in inglese ogni luogo davanti a cui passi, o cinque luoghi che conosci bene.

pt.t: A minha cidade: lugares na cidade
pt.g: Aprende os lugares da tua cidade e a dizer o que fazes lá.
p: Lugares: bank, supermarket, post office, library, station, park.
Diz o que fazes lá: I buy food at the supermarket; I borrow books from the library.
Usa near e far from: The station is near my house.
pt.q: Que lugares há perto da tua casa? Diz três.
pt.c: Diz hoje em inglês o nome de cada lugar por onde passares, ou de cinco lugares que conheces bem.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda os lugares da sua cidade e a dizer o que você faz lá.
p: Lugares: bank, supermarket, post office, library, station, park.
Diga o que faz lá: I buy food at the supermarket; I borrow books from the library.
Use near e far from: The station is near my house.
pt_BR.q: Que lugares ficam perto da sua casa? Diga três.
pt_BR.c: Diga hoje em inglês o nome de cada lugar por onde passar, ou de cinco lugares que você conhece bem.

vocab.ex: The bank opens at nine.
I go to the supermarket on Saturdays.
Is the post office open today?
I study at the library.
The station is near the park.
My school is near my house.

target.gram: At for places where you do something: at the bank, at the station. Near = not far: near the park.

en.g: Ask strangers politely how to find a place.
p: Start with Excuse me to get attention politely.
Ask Where is the station? or Is there a pharmacy near here?
Ask How do I get to the museum? and finish with Thank you very much.
en.q: Imagine you are lost in London. How do you ask me for the nearest station?
en.c: Practise three direction questions aloud for places in your own town.

de.g: Du lernst, Fremde höflich nach dem Weg zu fragen.
p: Fang mit Excuse me an, um höflich Aufmerksamkeit zu bekommen.
Frag Where is the station? oder Is there a pharmacy near here?
Frag How do I get to the museum? und bedanke dich mit Thank you very much.
de.q: Stell dir vor, du hast dich in London verlaufen. Wie fragst du nach dem nächsten Bahnhof?
de.c: Übe laut drei Fragen nach dem Weg zu Orten in deiner Stadt.

es.g: Aprende a preguntar con educación a un desconocido cómo encontrar un lugar.
p: Empieza con Excuse me para llamar la atención con educación.
Pregunta Where is the station? o Is there a pharmacy near here?
Pregunta How do I get to the museum? y termina con Thank you very much.
es.q: Imagina que te pierdes en Londres. ¿Cómo me preguntas por la estación más cercana?
es.c: Practica en voz alta tres preguntas para llegar a lugares de tu ciudad.

fr.g: Demander poliment à un inconnu comment trouver un lieu.
p: Commence par Excuse me pour attirer l'attention poliment.
Demande Where is the station? ou Is there a pharmacy near here?
Demande How do I get to the museum? et termine par Thank you very much.
fr.q: Imagine que tu es perdu à Londres. Comment me demandes-tu la gare la plus proche ?
fr.c: Entraîne-toi à voix haute avec trois questions pour aller à des lieux de ta ville.

it.g: Impari a chiedere con gentilezza a uno sconosciuto come trovare un posto.
p: Inizia con Excuse me per attirare l'attenzione con garbo.
Chiedi Where is the station? o Is there a pharmacy near here?
Chiedi How do I get to the museum? e chiudi con Thank you very much.
it.q: Immagina di esserti perso a Londra. Come mi chiedi la stazione più vicina?
it.c: Esercitati ad alta voce con tre domande per raggiungere luoghi della tua città.

pt.g: Aprende a perguntar com educação a um desconhecido como chegar a um sítio.
p: Começa com Excuse me para chamar a atenção com educação.
Pergunta Where is the station? ou Is there a pharmacy near here?
Pergunta How do I get to the museum? e termina com Thank you very much.
pt.q: Imagina que estás perdido em Londres. Como me perguntas pela estação mais próxima?
pt.c: Treina em voz alta três perguntas para chegar a sítios da tua cidade.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a perguntar com educação a um desconhecido como chegar a um lugar.
p: Comece com Excuse me para chamar a atenção com educação.
Pergunte Where is the station? ou Is there a pharmacy near here?
Pergunte How do I get to the museum? e termine com Thank you very much.
pt_BR.q: Imagine que você está perdido em Londres. Como me pergunta pela estação mais próxima?
pt_BR.c: Treine em voz alta três perguntas para chegar a lugares da sua cidade.

vocab.ex: Excuse me, can you help me?
Where is the bus station?
Is there a café near here?
How do I get to the museum?
The pharmacy is open until ten.
Sorry, I'm lost.

target.gram: Polite direction questions: Excuse me, where is...? / Is there a... near here? / How do I get to...?

en.g: Give simple directions so someone can find a place.
p: Go straight on, turn left, turn right, take the second street on the left.
It's on the corner, it's opposite the bank, it's next to the café.
Use imperatives for directions: Go, turn, cross, take, with no you.
en.q: How do you get from your home to the nearest shop? Give me directions.
en.c: Write directions from your door to a place you visit often, in four steps.

de.g: Du lernst, einfache Wegbeschreibungen zu geben.
p: Go straight on, turn left, turn right, take the second street on the left.
It's on the corner, it's opposite the bank, it's next to the café.
Für Wegbeschreibungen nimmt man den Imperativ: Go, turn, cross, take, ohne you.
de.q: Wie kommt man von deiner Wohnung zum nächsten Laden? Beschreib mir den Weg.
de.c: Schreib den Weg von deiner Tür zu einem Ort, den du oft besuchst, in vier Schritten.

es.g: Aprende a dar indicaciones sencillas para que alguien encuentre un lugar.
p: Go straight on, turn left, turn right, take the second street on the left.
It's on the corner, it's opposite the bank, it's next to the café.
Para indicar se usa el imperativo: Go, turn, cross, take, sin you.
es.q: ¿Cómo se llega desde tu casa a la tienda más cercana? Dame indicaciones.
es.c: Escribe en cuatro pasos cómo llegar desde tu puerta a un sitio al que vas a menudo.

fr.g: Donner des indications simples pour qu'on trouve un lieu.
p: Go straight on, turn left, turn right, take the second street on the left.
It's on the corner, it's opposite the bank, it's next to the café.
On utilise l'impératif : Go, turn, cross, take, sans you.
fr.q: Comment va-t-on de chez toi au magasin le plus proche ? Indique-moi le chemin.
fr.c: Écris en quatre étapes le chemin de ta porte à un lieu où tu vas souvent.

it.g: Impari a dare indicazioni semplici per trovare un posto.
p: Go straight on, turn left, turn right, take the second street on the left.
It's on the corner, it's opposite the bank, it's next to the café.
Per le indicazioni si usa l'imperativo: Go, turn, cross, take, senza you.
it.q: Come si va da casa tua al negozio più vicino? Dammi le indicazioni.
it.c: Scrivi in quattro passi la strada dalla tua porta a un posto dove vai spesso.

pt.g: Aprende a dar indicações simples para alguém encontrar um sítio.
p: Go straight on, turn left, turn right, take the second street on the left.
It's on the corner, it's opposite the bank, it's next to the café.
Nas indicações usa-se o imperativo: Go, turn, cross, take, sem you.
pt.q: Como se vai da tua casa à loja mais próxima? Dá-me indicações.
pt.c: Escreve em quatro passos o caminho da tua porta até um sítio onde vais muitas vezes.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a dar direções simples para alguém encontrar um lugar.
p: Go straight on, turn left, turn right, take the second street on the left.
It's on the corner, it's opposite the bank, it's next to the café.
Nas direções se usa o imperativo: Go, turn, cross, take, sem you.
pt_BR.q: Como se vai da sua casa até a loja mais próxima? Me dê as direções.
pt_BR.c: Escreva em quatro passos o caminho da sua porta até um lugar que você frequenta.

vocab.ex: Go straight on for two minutes.
Turn left at the traffic lights.
Turn right after the bank.
The café is on the corner.
The station is opposite the park.
Cross the street at the lights.

target.gram: Directions use the imperative (base verb, no subject): Turn left. Go straight on. Take the first right.

en.g: Talk about how you travel around your town and further away.
p: Use by for transport: by bus, by train, by car, by bike, by taxi.
But say on foot when you walk: I go to work on foot.
Use get on and get off for buses and trains: Get off at the next stop.
en.q: How do you usually get to work, school or the shops?
en.c: Say in English how you travelled every time you move today.

de.g: Du lernst, darüber zu sprechen, wie du dich in der Stadt und weiter weg fortbewegst.
p: By steht vor Verkehrsmitteln: by bus, by train, by car, by bike, by taxi.
Aber zu Fuß heißt on foot: I go to work on foot.
Get on und get off für Bus und Bahn: Get off at the next stop.
de.q: Wie kommst du normalerweise zur Arbeit, zur Schule oder zum Einkaufen?
de.c: Sag heute bei jedem Weg auf Englisch, wie du unterwegs warst.

es.g: Aprende a hablar de cómo te mueves por tu ciudad y más lejos.
p: Usa by con el transporte: by bus, by train, by car, by bike, by taxi.
Pero andando se dice on foot: I go to work on foot.
Usa get on y get off para autobuses y trenes: Get off at the next stop.
es.q: ¿Cómo sueles ir al trabajo, a clase o de compras?
es.c: Di en inglés cómo te desplazas cada vez que vayas a algún sitio hoy.

fr.g: Parler de ta façon de te déplacer en ville et plus loin.
p: On utilise by pour le moyen : by bus, by train, by car, by bike, by taxi.
Mais à pied se dit on foot : I go to work on foot.
Get on et get off pour bus et trains : Get off at the next stop.
fr.q: Comment vas-tu d'habitude au travail, en cours ou faire tes courses ?
fr.c: Dis en anglais comment tu te déplaces à chaque trajet aujourd'hui.

it.g: Impari a parlare di come ti sposti in città e più lontano.
p: Con i mezzi si usa by: by bus, by train, by car, by bike, by taxi.
Ma a piedi si dice on foot: I go to work on foot.
Get on e get off per autobus e treni: Get off at the next stop.
it.q: Come vai di solito al lavoro, a scuola o a fare la spesa?
it.c: Di' in inglese come ti sposti ogni volta che vai da qualche parte oggi.

pt.g: Aprende a falar de como te deslocas na cidade e para mais longe.
p: Usa by com os transportes: by bus, by train, by car, by bike, by taxi.
Mas a pé diz-se on foot: I go to work on foot.
Usa get on e get off para autocarros e comboios: Get off at the next stop.
pt.q: Como costumas ir para o trabalho, para as aulas ou às compras?
pt.c: Diz em inglês como te deslocas sempre que fores a algum lado hoje.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a falar de como você se locomove pela cidade e para mais longe.
p: Use by com os transportes: by bus, by train, by car, by bike, by taxi.
Mas a pé se diz on foot: I go to work on foot.
Use get on e get off para ônibus e trens: Get off at the next stop.
pt_BR.q: Como você costuma ir para o trabalho, a escola ou as compras?
pt_BR.c: Diga em inglês como você se locomove toda vez que for a algum lugar hoje.

vocab.ex: I go to school by bus.
We travel to Paris by train.
She goes to work on foot.
Let's take a taxi.
Get on the bus here.
Get off at the third stop.

target.gram: By + transport with no article: by car, by bus (not by the bus). Walking: on foot.

en.g: Buy a train or bus ticket with confidence.
p: Ask for A single to Oxford, please or A return to Oxford, please.
A single is one way; a return goes there and back (US: one-way and round-trip).
Ask Which platform is it? and What time is the next train?
en.q: Imagine you are at a station. Ask me for a ticket to a city you like.
en.c: Write a short ticket-office dialogue in English with four lines.

de.g: Du lernst, sicher eine Zug- oder Busfahrkarte zu kaufen.
p: Verlang A single to Oxford, please oder A return to Oxford, please.
A single ist einfach, a return hin und zurück (amerikanisch one-way und round-trip).
Frag Which platform is it? und What time is the next train?
de.q: Stell dir vor, du bist am Bahnhof. Verlang bei mir eine Fahrkarte in eine Stadt, die du magst.
de.c: Schreib einen kurzen Dialog am Fahrkartenschalter auf Englisch, mit vier Zeilen.

es.g: Aprende a comprar un billete de tren o autobús con seguridad.
p: Pide A single to Oxford, please o A return to Oxford, please.
A single es solo ida; a return es ida y vuelta (en EE. UU. one-way y round-trip).
Pregunta Which platform is it? y What time is the next train?
es.q: Imagina que estás en la estación. Pídeme un billete a una ciudad que te guste.
es.c: Escribe un breve diálogo en la taquilla, en inglés, de cuatro líneas.

fr.g: Acheter un billet de train ou de bus avec assurance.
p: Demande A single to Oxford, please ou A return to Oxford, please.
A single est un aller simple, a return un aller-retour (américain : one-way, round-trip).
Demande Which platform is it? et What time is the next train?
fr.q: Imagine que tu es à la gare. Demande-moi un billet pour une ville que tu aimes.
fr.c: Écris un court dialogue au guichet, en anglais, en quatre répliques.

it.g: Impari a comprare con sicurezza un biglietto del treno o dell'autobus.
p: Chiedi A single to Oxford, please o A return to Oxford, please.
A single è solo andata, a return andata e ritorno (in americano one-way e round-trip).
Chiedi Which platform is it? e What time is the next train?
it.q: Immagina di essere in stazione. Chiedimi un biglietto per una città che ti piace.
it.c: Scrivi un breve dialogo in biglietteria, in inglese, di quattro battute.

pt.g: Aprende a comprar um bilhete de comboio ou autocarro com confiança.
p: Pede A single to Oxford, please ou A return to Oxford, please.
A single é só ida; a return é ida e volta (nos EUA one-way e round-trip).
Pergunta Which platform is it? e What time is the next train?
pt.q: Imagina que estás na estação. Pede-me um bilhete para uma cidade de que gostes.
pt.c: Escreve um pequeno diálogo na bilheteira, em inglês, com quatro falas.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a comprar uma passagem de trem ou ônibus com confiança.
p: Peça A single to Oxford, please ou A return to Oxford, please.
A single é só ida; a return é ida e volta (nos EUA one-way e round-trip).
Pergunte Which platform is it? e What time is the next train?
pt_BR.q: Imagine que você está na estação. Me peça uma passagem para uma cidade de que gosta.
pt_BR.c: Escreva um pequeno diálogo na bilheteria, em inglês, com quatro falas.

vocab.ex: Where can I buy a ticket?
A single to York, please.
Two returns to Bath, please.
The train leaves from platform four.
Let's check the timetable.
When is the next train to Leeds?

target.gram: A single/return to + place, please. Ask: What time does the next train leave? Which platform?

en.g: Say what you can and can't do with can.
p: Can is the same for everyone: I can, she can, they can, never she cans.
The verb after can has no to: I can swim, not I can to swim.
Negative can't, question Can you...? Short answers: Yes, I can. No, I can't.
en.q: What is something you can do well, and something you can't do yet?
en.c: Write three things you can do and three you can't do yet, then pick one to learn.

de.g: Du lernst, mit can zu sagen, was du kannst und nicht kannst.
p: Can ist für alle gleich: I can, she can, they can, nie she cans.
Nach can steht das Verb ohne to: I can swim, nicht I can to swim.
Verneinung can't, Frage Can you...? Kurzantworten: Yes, I can. No, I can't.
de.q: Was kannst du gut, und was kannst du noch nicht?
de.c: Schreib drei Dinge, die du kannst, und drei, die du noch nicht kannst, und wähle eins zum Lernen.

es.g: Aprende a decir lo que sabes y no sabes hacer con can.
p: Can es igual para todos: I can, she can, they can, nunca she cans.
El verbo tras can va sin to: I can swim, no I can to swim.
Negativa can't, pregunta Can you...? Respuestas cortas: Yes, I can. No, I can't.
es.q: ¿Qué sabes hacer bien y qué no sabes hacer todavía?
es.c: Escribe tres cosas que sabes hacer y tres que aún no, y elige una para aprender.

fr.t: Can et can't pour les capacités
fr.g: Dire ce que tu sais faire ou non avec can.
p: Can est identique pour tous : I can, she can, they can, jamais she cans.
Le verbe après can n'a pas de to : I can swim, pas I can to swim.
Négation can't, question Can you...? Réponses courtes : Yes, I can. No, I can't.
fr.q: Qu'est-ce que tu sais bien faire, et que ne sais-tu pas encore faire ?
fr.c: Écris trois choses que tu sais faire et trois pas encore, puis choisis-en une à apprendre.

it.t: Can e can't per le capacità
it.g: Impari a dire cosa sai e non sai fare con can.
p: Can è uguale per tutti: I can, she can, they can, mai she cans.
Il verbo dopo can non ha il to: I can swim, non I can to swim.
Negativa can't, domanda Can you...? Risposte brevi: Yes, I can. No, I can't.
it.q: Cosa sai fare bene, e cosa non sai ancora fare?
it.c: Scrivi tre cose che sai fare e tre che non sai ancora fare, e scegline una da imparare.

pt.g: Aprende a dizer o que sabes e não sabes fazer com can.
p: Can é igual para todos: I can, she can, they can, nunca she cans.
O verbo depois de can não leva to: I can swim, e não I can to swim.
Negativa can't, pergunta Can you...? Respostas curtas: Yes, I can. No, I can't.
pt.q: O que sabes fazer bem, e o que ainda não sabes fazer?
pt.c: Escreve três coisas que sabes fazer e três que ainda não sabes, e escolhe uma para aprender.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a dizer o que você sabe e não sabe fazer com can.
p: Can é igual para todos: I can, she can, they can, nunca she cans.
O verbo depois de can fica sem to: I can swim, e não I can to swim.
Negativa can't, pergunta Can you...? Respostas curtas: Yes, I can. No, I can't.
pt_BR.q: O que você sabe fazer bem, e o que ainda não sabe fazer?
pt_BR.c: Escreva três coisas que você sabe fazer e três que ainda não, e escolha uma para aprender.

vocab.ex: I can speak two languages.
He can't drive yet.
Can you play the piano?
My son can swim very well.
I can't cook, but I can bake.
She can ride a bike.

target.gram: Can + base verb, same for all persons: She can dance (not She cans dance / can to dance).

en.g: Talk about what you do in your free time.
p: Hobbies: reading, cooking, painting, gaming, gardening, taking photos.
Ask What do you do in your free time? or What are your hobbies?
Answer with the present simple: I read a lot. I play video games at the weekend.
en.q: What do you love doing in your free time?
en.c: Tell someone, or me, about your favourite hobby in three English sentences.

de.g: Du lernst, über deine Freizeit zu sprechen.
p: Hobbys: reading, cooking, painting, gaming, gardening, taking photos.
Frag What do you do in your free time? oder What are your hobbies?
Antworte im present simple: I read a lot. I play video games at the weekend.
de.q: Was machst du in deiner Freizeit am liebsten?
de.c: Erzähl jemandem, oder mir, in drei englischen Sätzen von deinem Lieblingshobby.

es.g: Aprende a hablar de lo que haces en tu tiempo libre.
p: Aficiones: reading, cooking, painting, gaming, gardening, taking photos.
Pregunta What do you do in your free time? o What are your hobbies?
Responde con el present simple: I read a lot. I play video games at the weekend.
es.q: ¿Qué te encanta hacer en tu tiempo libre?
es.c: Cuéntale a alguien, o a mí, tu afición favorita en tres frases en inglés.

fr.g: Parler de ce que tu fais pendant ton temps libre.
p: Loisirs : reading, cooking, painting, gaming, gardening, taking photos.
Demande What do you do in your free time? ou What are your hobbies?
Réponds au present simple : I read a lot. I play video games at the weekend.
fr.q: Qu'adores-tu faire pendant ton temps libre ?
fr.c: Parle de ton loisir préféré à quelqu'un, ou à moi, en trois phrases en anglais.

it.g: Impari a parlare di cosa fai nel tempo libero.
p: Hobby: reading, cooking, painting, gaming, gardening, taking photos.
Chiedi What do you do in your free time? o What are your hobbies?
Rispondi con il present simple: I read a lot. I play video games at the weekend.
it.q: Cosa ami fare nel tuo tempo libero?
it.c: Racconta a qualcuno, o a me, il tuo hobby preferito in tre frasi in inglese.

pt.g: Aprende a falar do que fazes nos teus tempos livres.
p: Passatempos: reading, cooking, painting, gaming, gardening, taking photos.
Pergunta What do you do in your free time? ou What are your hobbies?
Responde no present simple: I read a lot. I play video games at the weekend.
pt.q: O que adoras fazer nos teus tempos livres?
pt.c: Fala a alguém, ou a mim, do teu passatempo preferido em três frases em inglês.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a falar sobre o que você faz no seu tempo livre.
p: Hobbies: reading, cooking, painting, gaming, gardening, taking photos.
Pergunte What do you do in your free time? ou What are your hobbies?
Responda no present simple: I read a lot. I play video games on the weekend.
pt_BR.q: O que você adora fazer no seu tempo livre?
pt_BR.c: Conte para alguém, ou para mim, sobre seu hobby favorito em três frases em inglês.

vocab.ex: What do you do in your free time?
My favourite hobby is painting.
Reading helps me relax.
My grandma loves gardening.
I take photos of old buildings.
My kids play video games after school.

target.gram: Talk about hobbies with the present simple: I paint on Sundays. She plays chess every week.

en.g: Use -ing after verbs of liking to talk about activities.
p: After like, love, enjoy and hate, use verb + -ing: I love dancing.
Negatives and questions: I don't like waiting. Do you enjoy cooking?
Spelling: dance becomes dancing, swim becomes swimming, read becomes reading.
en.q: What do you love doing, and what do you hate doing?
en.c: Make four sentences today with love, like, don't like and hate plus an -ing verb.

de.g: Du lernst, nach Verben des Mögens die -ing-Form für Tätigkeiten zu benutzen.
p: Nach like, love, enjoy und hate kommt Verb + -ing: I love dancing.
Verneinung und Frage: I don't like waiting. Do you enjoy cooking?
Schreibung: dance wird dancing, swim wird swimming, read wird reading.
de.q: Was machst du total gern, und was hasst du?
de.c: Bilde heute vier Sätze mit love, like, don't like und hate plus -ing-Verb.

es.g: Aprende a usar -ing tras los verbos de gusto para hablar de actividades.
p: Tras like, love, enjoy y hate va el verbo + -ing: I love dancing.
Negativas y preguntas: I don't like waiting. Do you enjoy cooking?
Ortografía: dance pasa a dancing, swim a swimming, read a reading.
es.q: ¿Qué te encanta hacer y qué odias hacer?
es.c: Haz hoy cuatro frases con love, like, don't like y hate más un verbo en -ing.

fr.g: Utiliser la forme -ing après les verbes de goût pour parler d'activités.
p: Après like, love, enjoy et hate, on met verbe + -ing : I love dancing.
Négation et question : I don't like waiting. Do you enjoy cooking?
Orthographe : dance donne dancing, swim donne swimming, read donne reading.
fr.q: Qu'adores-tu faire, et que détestes-tu faire ?
fr.c: Fais quatre phrases aujourd'hui avec love, like, don't like et hate plus un verbe en -ing.

it.g: Impari a usare la forma in -ing dopo i verbi di gradimento.
p: Dopo like, love, enjoy e hate si usa verbo + -ing: I love dancing.
Negative e domande: I don't like waiting. Do you enjoy cooking?
Ortografia: dance diventa dancing, swim diventa swimming, read diventa reading.
it.q: Cosa ami fare, e cosa odi fare?
it.c: Fai oggi quattro frasi con love, like, don't like e hate più un verbo in -ing.

pt.g: Aprende a usar -ing depois dos verbos de gosto para falar de atividades.
p: Depois de like, love, enjoy e hate usa-se verbo + -ing: I love dancing.
Negativas e perguntas: I don't like waiting. Do you enjoy cooking?
Ortografia: dance passa a dancing, swim a swimming, read a reading.
pt.q: O que adoras fazer, e o que detestas fazer?
pt.c: Faz hoje quatro frases com love, like, don't like e hate mais um verbo em -ing.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a usar -ing depois dos verbos de gosto para falar de atividades.
p: Depois de like, love, enjoy e hate vem verbo + -ing: I love dancing.
Negativas e perguntas: I don't like waiting. Do you enjoy cooking?
Ortografia: dance vira dancing, swim vira swimming, read vira reading.
pt_BR.q: O que você adora fazer, e o que odeia fazer?
pt_BR.c: Faça hoje quatro frases com love, like, don't like e hate mais um verbo em -ing.

vocab.ex: I love dancing.
She likes reading in bed.
We enjoy walking by the sea.
I hate waiting for the bus.
I don't mind cooking.
They love swimming in summer.

target.gram: Like/love/enjoy/hate + verb-ing: I enjoy cooking. Double the consonant in short verbs: run-running.

en.g: Use the right verb for each sport: play, go or do.
p: Play for ball games and games against others: play football, play chess.
Go for activities ending in -ing: go running, go swimming, go cycling.
Do for many individual activities: do yoga, do karate, do exercise.
en.q: Which sports do you play, go or do, or love watching?
en.c: Write one sentence each with play, go and do about sports you or friends practise.

de.g: Du lernst das richtige Verb für jede Sportart: play, go oder do.
p: Play für Ballsportarten und Spiele gegen andere: play football, play chess.
Go für Aktivitäten auf -ing: go running, go swimming, go cycling.
Do für viele Einzelaktivitäten: do yoga, do karate, do exercise.
de.q: Welche Sportarten machst du, oder schaust du gern zu?
de.c: Schreib je einen Satz mit play, go und do über Sport, den du oder Freunde machen.

es.g: Aprende el verbo correcto para cada deporte: play, go o do.
p: Play para deportes de pelota y juegos contra otros: play football, play chess.
Go para actividades en -ing: go running, go swimming, go cycling.
Do para muchas actividades individuales: do yoga, do karate, do exercise.
es.q: ¿Qué deportes practicas o te encanta ver?
es.c: Escribe una frase con play, otra con go y otra con do sobre deportes que tú o tus amigos hacéis.

fr.g: Choisir le bon verbe pour chaque sport : play, go ou do.
p: Play pour les sports de ballon et les jeux contre d'autres : play football, play chess.
Go pour les activités en -ing : go running, go swimming, go cycling.
Do pour beaucoup d'activités individuelles : do yoga, do karate, do exercise.
fr.q: Quels sports pratiques-tu, ou adores-tu regarder ?
fr.c: Écris une phrase avec play, une avec go et une avec do sur des sports que toi ou tes amis pratiquez.

it.g: Impari il verbo giusto per ogni sport: play, go o do.
p: Play per gli sport con la palla e i giochi contro altri: play football, play chess.
Go per le attività in -ing: go running, go swimming, go cycling.
Do per molte attività individuali: do yoga, do karate, do exercise.
it.q: Quali sport pratichi, o ami guardare?
it.c: Scrivi una frase con play, una con go e una con do sugli sport che fai tu o i tuoi amici.

pt.g: Aprende o verbo certo para cada desporto: play, go ou do.
p: Play para desportos com bola e jogos contra outros: play football, play chess.
Go para atividades em -ing: go running, go swimming, go cycling.
Do para muitas atividades individuais: do yoga, do karate, do exercise.
pt.q: Que desportos praticas, ou adoras ver?
pt.c: Escreve uma frase com play, outra com go e outra com do sobre desportos que tu ou os teus amigos praticam.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda o verbo certo para cada esporte: play, go ou do.
p: Play para esportes com bola e jogos contra outros: play soccer, play chess.
Go para atividades em -ing: go running, go swimming, go cycling.
Do para muitas atividades individuais: do yoga, do karate, do exercise.
pt_BR.q: Que esportes você pratica, ou adora assistir?
pt_BR.c: Escreva uma frase com play, outra com go e outra com do sobre esportes que você ou seus amigos praticam.

vocab.ex: We play football on Sundays.
Do you play tennis?
I go running in the park.
She goes swimming twice a week.
My mum does yoga every morning.
Which team do you support?

target.gram: Play + ball games (play basketball), go + -ing activities (go cycling), do + other activities (do judo).

en.g: Talk about the weather, a favourite topic in English small talk.
p: Ask What's the weather like? and answer It's sunny, it's cloudy, it's windy.
For rain and snow now, say It's raining or It's snowing.
Temperature: It's hot, warm, cool, cold; a lovely day is perfect for small talk.
en.q: What's the weather like where you are right now?
en.c: Describe the weather aloud in English this morning and again this evening.

de.g: Du lernst, über das Wetter zu sprechen, ein Lieblingsthema im englischen Small Talk.
p: Frag What's the weather like? und antworte It's sunny, it's cloudy, it's windy.
Für Regen und Schnee gerade jetzt: It's raining oder It's snowing.
Temperatur: It's hot, warm, cool, cold; a lovely day passt perfekt zum Small Talk.
de.q: Wie ist das Wetter gerade bei dir?
de.c: Beschreib heute Morgen und heute Abend das Wetter laut auf Englisch.

es.g: Aprende a hablar del tiempo, un tema estrella de la charla en inglés.
p: Pregunta What's the weather like? y responde It's sunny, it's cloudy, it's windy.
Para lluvia y nieve ahora, di It's raining o It's snowing.
Temperatura: It's hot, warm, cool, cold; a lovely day es perfecto para charlar.
es.c: Describe el tiempo en voz alta en inglés por la mañana y otra vez por la noche.

fr.g: Parler du temps qu'il fait, sujet favori des conversations en anglais.
p: Demande What's the weather like? et réponds It's sunny, it's cloudy, it's windy.
Pour la pluie et la neige en ce moment : It's raining ou It's snowing.
Températures : It's hot, warm, cool, cold ; a lovely day, parfait pour papoter.
fr.q: Quel temps fait-il là où tu es en ce moment ?
fr.c: Décris la météo à voix haute en anglais ce matin, puis ce soir.

it.g: Impari a parlare del tempo, l'argomento preferito delle chiacchiere in inglese.
p: Chiedi What's the weather like? e rispondi It's sunny, it's cloudy, it's windy.
Per pioggia e neve in questo momento: It's raining o It's snowing.
Temperatura: It's hot, warm, cool, cold; a lovely day è perfetto per chiacchierare.
it.q: Che tempo fa adesso dove sei?
it.c: Descrivi il tempo ad alta voce in inglese stamattina e di nuovo stasera.

pt.g: Aprende a falar do tempo, o tema preferido das conversas de circunstância em inglês.
p: Pergunta What's the weather like? e responde It's sunny, it's cloudy, it's windy.
Para chuva e neve agora diz It's raining ou It's snowing.
Temperatura: It's hot, warm, cool, cold; a lovely day é perfeito para conversar.
pt.q: Como está o tempo aí onde estás agora?
pt.c: Descreve o tempo em voz alta em inglês de manhã e outra vez à noite.

pt_BR.g: Aprenda a falar do tempo, o assunto favorito do bate-papo em inglês.
p: Pergunte What's the weather like? e responda It's sunny, it's cloudy, it's windy.
Para chuva e neve agora diga It's raining ou It's snowing.
Temperatura: It's hot, warm, cool, cold; a lovely day é perfeito para puxar papo.
pt_BR.q: Como está o tempo aí onde você está agora?
pt_BR.c: Descreva o tempo em voz alta em inglês de manhã e de novo à noite.

vocab.ex: What's the weather like in Rome?
It's sunny and warm today.
It's cloudy, but it's not cold.
Take an umbrella. It's raining.
It's very windy by the sea.
It's cold in the morning.

target.gram: Weather uses it: It's sunny. It's raining. Adjective: rain-rainy, sun-sunny, wind-windy, cloud-cloudy.
